reasoning: On the season so far the Clippers are the stronger team; with home court the Clippers start about 3 points better, in a game of about 236 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Pelicans.
The mental side leans about 3 points towards the Pelicans (look-ahead, revenge).
Bottom line: the Pelicans win 50 times in 100; most games like this end between 209 and 257 total points.
